"import cadquery as cq

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Open orthogonal line chain on the YZ plane (local sketch coords, mm)
# Local (u, v) -> global (x, y, z) = (0, u, v)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------

# Named YZ sketch plane used to map local sketch coordinates to world
P = cq.Plane.named("YZ")

# Exact local sketch coordinates of the chain vertices (mm)
local_pts = [
    (0, 0),      # start of segment 1
    (19, 0),     # end seg 1 / start seg 2
    (19, 14),    # end seg 2 / start seg 3
    (7, 14),     # end seg 3 / start seg 4
    (7, 32),     # end seg 4 / start seg 5
    (-15, 32),   # end seg 5 / start seg 6
    (-15, -9),   # end seg 6 (chain left open)
]

# Map local sketch coordinates to world coordinates on the YZ plane
world_pts = [P.toWorldCoords((u, v)) for (u, v) in local_pts]

# Build exactly the 6 required line edges (shared endpoints -> open chain)
edges = [
    cq.Edge.makeLine(world_pts[i], world_pts[i + 1])
    for i in range(len(world_pts) - 1)
]

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Verification
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Exactly 6 curve entities
assert len(edges) == 6, f"Expected 6 edges, got {len(edges)}"

# Consecutive segments share truly coincident endpoints (by construction);
# verify start/end points match numerically
for i in range(len(edges) - 1):
    end_i = edges[i].endPoint()
    start_j = edges[i + 1].startPoint()
    assert end_i.toTuple() == start_j.toTuple(), (
        f"Non-coincident junction between edge {i} and edge {i + 1}"
    )

# Open chain: first point != last point => no closed profile
assert world_pts[0].toTuple() != world_pts[-1].toTuple(), "Chain must be open"

# All entities coplanar on x = 0 (YZ plane)
for e in edges:
    for v in (e.startPoint(), e.endPoint()):
        assert abs(v.x) < 1e-9, "All geometry must lie on the YZ plane"

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Export as a compound of edges to sketch.step
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
compound = cq.Compound.makeCompound(edges)
cq.exporters.export(compound, "sketch.step")

print("Exported sketch.step: 6 coplanar line edges, open chain (0 closed profiles).")"
